lithium-salts.introduction: Compare technical identifiers and published specifications, inspect documentation and choose an approved package—or discuss your project with Winigen.

battery-solvents.introduction: Winigen Materials supplies low-moisture carbonate, ether, nitrile, ester, fluorinated, and specialty solvents for lithium-ion, sodium-ion, and advanced electrolyte research. Selected research packages are available for online ordering, with bulk and custom quantities available by quotation.

electrolyte-additives.introduction: Winigen Materials supplies battery electrolyte additives for SEI and CEI formation, silicon-anode stabilization, high-voltage cycling, fast-charge, and low-temperature research. Selected research packages are available for online ordering, with larger and custom quantities available by quotation.

next-generation-salts.introduction: Winigen Materials supplies sodium and potassium electrolyte salts for alternative-cation battery research, formulation screening, and compatibility studies. Selected research-scale packages are available for online ordering, with larger quantities available by quotation.

solid-state-electrolytes.introduction: Winigen Materials supplies oxide, sulfide, and halide solid-state electrolyte materials for conductivity screening, composite-electrode development, coating studies, and advanced battery R&D. Selected research packages are available for online ordering, with bulk quantities and custom requirements handled by quotation.
solid-state-electrolytes.faq:
FAQ

Common Questions

Where can I order solid-state electrolyte materials for battery research?

Winigen Materials supplies oxide and sulfide solid-state electrolyte materials in selected research-scale package sizes, with larger quantities and custom requirements available by quotation.

What solid-state electrolyte materials are listed?

Winigen lists oxide powders and slurries, sulfide electrolyte powders, and LLZTO.

Are particle-size and conductivity data available?

Product pages list particle-size, conductivity, moisture, impurity, and characterization data where available from the source deck.

Can particle size or slurry formulation be customized?

Several oxide and LLZTO materials can be matched to customer particle-size or formulation requirements; final specifications should be confirmed through RFQ.

custom-formulations.introduction: Begin with a published reference electrolyte or stock solution, or describe a custom program. Application-specific formulations are inquiry-led—not assumed to be off-the-shelf inventory.

active-materials.introduction: Winigen Materials supplies cathode and anode active materials for electrode formulation, cell screening, and material down-selection. Grades, research quantities, bulk supply, documentation, and application requirements are confirmed by quotation.

functional-coatings.introduction: Winigen Materials supports application-led selection of boehmite, alumina, and mesoporous ceramic materials for separator coating, electrode coating, edge insulation, thermal-stability layers, local slurry development, and pilot-line or FAT evaluation. Product, morphology, process, scale, and documentation requirements are confirmed through technical RFQ and customer-specific qualification.

mxene-materials.introduction: Winigen Materials supplies research-grade MXene powders across Ti-, V-, Nb-, Mo- and Ta-containing chemistries in multilayer and single-/few-layer forms. All 24 listed powder grades are available for direct online ordering, with bulk and custom requirements supported by quotation.
